big_case.notes: While every scheduled execution carries grave life-or-death stakes for the applicant and the underlying 2001 Rob Andrew murder had prior capital-litigation visibility through co-defendant Brenda Andrew's case, this third successive state post-conviction stay application was procedurally barred below under Okla. Stat. tit. 22, section 1089(D)(8) and ended in a routine, unexplained two-sentence denial of both the stay and certiorari with no noted dissents, no separate writings, and no doctrinal or institutional impact.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed on 2026-11-09 (~22:45-22:47 UTC) while the application was genuinely unresolved ahead of the 2026-11-12 denial. All 16 logged shell calls were captured (result_capture_coverage = 1.0) and accessed only the staged arrival record, committed statpack, and general fedcourts corpus queries (26-6095 not in corpus; 8 recent granted applications). No CourtListener, web, or qp-topics lookups were made, and no outcome material existed.
